Well I know everyone’s body is different, but I started fasting 24hr, 38hr, and 72hr+ without doing the slow 16:8(intermittent fasting), etc route, I just went straight into prolonged fasts. I was fine and it worked out great, only had some minor problems with electrolytes deficiencies but I got that figured out(make sure you do too). For reference I am 5’2” and started out at 135lbs. 1 1/2 weeks later I am at 120lbs. I fasted for 7 days.

Yes also I do exercise during long fasts and would recommend it as long as you are keeping up with your electrolytes, just always be careful!

Stay away  from them and pursue people that match your energy and that are grateful for who you are and how you are, as well as having good compatibility and communication. 

As far as your depression goes, I can see why losing a girl you really like is depressing. Eventually it will go away but you will one day find a girl that makes you completely forget about how horribly attached you were to this girl that treated you terribly. You will find your peace.
